title: Can You Put Aluminum Foil in an Air Fryer?

seo.title: Can You Put Aluminum Foil in an Air Fryer?
seo.meta_description: Aluminum foil is not universally approved for air fryers. Check the model manual and, when allowed, keep airflow open and never leave loose foil near the heater.
seo.search_intent: Decide whether foil is allowed in a specific air fryer and, if the manufacturer permits it, use it without blocking airflow or contacting the heating element.

excerpt: Foil is not allowed the same way in every air fryer. Check the manual, keep airflow open, and never let a loose sheet reach the heating element.
content_html:
There is no universal yes-or-no answer for every air fryer. Some manufacturers allow aluminum foil under specific conditions, while others advise against it on certain models. Your appliance manual is the first authority.

Why foil can create problems

An air fryer cooks by moving very hot air at high speed. Foil that covers perforations or too much of the basket can restrict airflow and reduce cooking performance. A loose sheet can also be lifted toward the heating element.

Manufacturers do not all give the same rule

Philips advises against foil on several models because it can disrupt airflow and potentially be drawn into the heater if unsecured. COSORI allows foil in some units as long as airflow is not blocked, the foil is held down by food, and it stays away from heating elements. That difference is why model-specific instructions matter.

If your manual allows it

Use only the amount you need, keep ventilation areas open, and place food on top so the foil cannot move. Do not line the entire basket just to simplify cleanup, and do not preheat with an unsecured sheet.

Do not cover the parts designed to move air

Basket perforations and air inlets and outlets are part of the cooking system. Blocking them changes airflow, temperature, and cooking time. An air fryer is not simply a small conventional oven tray.

Be cautious with highly acidic foods

Tomato, citrus, and strongly acidic marinades can react with aluminum and affect flavor or the foil surface. A manufacturer-approved oven-safe dish may be a better choice when you need to contain liquids.

If the manual says no, the answer is no

It is not worth improvising just to save cleanup time. Model-specific baskets, liners, and accessories are safer choices when approved.

The useful rule is: manual first; if foil is permitted, use a small secured amount and never block airflow.

faq.question: Can I cover the whole basket with foil?
faq.answer: It is not a good idea because it can block airflow and change cooking performance.

faq.question: Can I preheat with an empty sheet of foil?
faq.answer: Not if it can move; the fan may lift it toward the heating element. Follow your model manual.

faq.question: Do all manufacturers allow foil?
faq.answer: No. Instructions vary by brand and model.
